title: Midday Brief — Thu 26 Nov

stories.board: Eisenkot signs deal with Golan's party
stories.headline: Eisenkot gets closer to forming a new Israeli government
stories.what: Gadi Eisenkot made a coalition deal (an agreement to govern together) with Yair Golan's Democrats party. The Democrats get several ministries but dropped their ask for the Justice Ministry.
stories.why: If Eisenkot gets 61 of 120 seats, Netanyahu would no longer be prime minister. He still needs more partners.
stories.sides: Eisenkot's camp says a new government could start next week; Netanyahu's Likud party now expects Eisenkot to form one without it, and Bennett warned against a rushed minority (too few seats) government.

stories.board: Zelenskyy warns big Russian power attack coming
stories.headline: Ukraine says Russia is getting ready for a huge strike
stories.what: Ukraine's leader Zelenskyy said Russia is almost ready for another big attack on power plants and supplies. Overnight, Russia fired missiles and 113 drones, and crews are fixing power in six regions.
stories.why: Winter is starting, and without power many Ukrainians lose heat and light.
stories.sides: No major disagreement. A US envoy says peace talks are stuck on who keeps which land.

quick_hits: For the first time in 100 years, the Macy's Thanksgiving parade in New York was moved because of a storm; it now runs Saturday.
EU leaders are meeting in Brussels and are split over how to keep paying to help Ukraine.
big_picture: Israel may be days from a new government, while Ukraine braces for a hard, cold winter.
